dedupe_keys.name: european cement and iron steel plants production data

description: The German Aerospace Center publishes two public Excel workbooks containing European cement and iron-and-steel plants, with WGS84 coordinates and annual production in million tonnes. Zenodo lists CC BY 4.0 and free file access. The provider assembled cement data from industryabout.com and steel data from that site, USGS, company reports and other public sources to examine industrial carbon-source locations for synthetic fuel pathways. Plant positions and production can seed spatial process-emissions or infrastructure-linkage simulation scenarios across Europe. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these two workbooks. A limitation is that the publication dates from 2021, while plant closures, capacities and product mixes may since have changed. The landing page does not state a single observation year, a validation protocol or whether annual production is reported or estimated at every site. Upstream source terms may apply to some fields. Neither workbook was downloaded and no location or production number was independently checked.
